description: Use when an agent needs to know right now which stock exchanges are open: open, lunch break, pre-market, after-hours or closed (with holiday name), local time, exact next open and close in UTC. One call checks up to 28 exchanges (default all) incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Official exchange calendars only; unknown exchange: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

exchanges.description: Comma-separated MIC codes or names, e.g. XNYS,XETR,XTKS. Optional, default: all exchanges.
